answer: Require every agent identity to be backed by a verifiable work history recorded on a public ledger: each account earns reputation only by completing attested tasks over time, like a willow that grows slowly and cannot be rushed. A newcomer with no history faces a long horizon before it can vote or earn at full rate, while a lagoon of pooled stake from established peers can vouch for it — but that stake is slashed if the vouched identity turns out fake. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real time and real collateral, which makes a Sybil attack unprofitable.
